flashcards.title: Net profit milestone
flashcards.fact: HDFC Bank reported ₹60,812 crore in net profit for FY24, reflecting strong consolidated performance and post-merger scale.

flashcards.title: Surging deposit base
flashcards.fact: HDFC Bank's total deposits grew 26.4% in FY24 to ₹23.8 lakh crore, up from ₹18.83 lakh crore in FY23.

flashcards.title: Extensive distribution
flashcards.fact: HDFC Bank expanded its branch network to over 8,735 branches and 20,938 ATMs across India.

flashcards.title: ₹40,000+ crore profit milestone
flashcards.fact: ICICI Bank recorded ₹40,888 crore in standalone profit after tax in FY24, up 28.2% from ₹31,896 crore in FY23.

flashcards.title: Superior asset quality
flashcards.fact: ICICI Bank's net NPA ratio improved to 0.42% at March 31, 2024, compared to 0.48% at March 31, 2023.

flashcards.title: Expanding loan book
flashcards.fact: ICICI Bank's total advances grew 16.2% year-on-year to ₹11.84 lakh crore at March 31, 2024.

flashcards.title: Contribution profit growth
flashcards.fact: Paytm reported operational revenue of ₹9,978 crore in FY24, with contribution profit expanding to ₹5,412 crore.

flashcards.title: Over 1 crore payment devices
flashcards.fact: Paytm's subscription merchant base reached 1.07 crore active devices (Soundboxes & Card Machines) in FY24.

flashcards.title: UPI payments leadership
flashcards.fact: Paytm continues as one of India's top 3 UPI payment apps, processing billions of GMV transactions annually.
